title: Return a departed character's items to the party
summary: When a character leaves the party, the DM can now send the items and coins they carried back to the party, so nothing is stranded with a character who is gone.
items: Taking a character out of the party (or hiding them) asks whether to return what they carry. Nothing moves unless the DM chooses; keeping it leaves everything with the character, as before.
The DM picks which items and how many coins go back, to the treasure pool (unclaimed, so the party can mark Need, Greed or Pass) or straight into a party fund.
Everything moves at once or not at all, each item gets a ledger line naming the character, attunements end, and the character's open pool claims are withdrawn and logged.
Fairness totals don't change, unidentified items stay unidentified for players, and a hidden character is never named to the party.
